question: Which PipelineHub role is required for Pod Add-ons > Toggle Auto Scheduling, and what schedules does this action control?

result.question: Which PipelineHub role is required for Pod Add-ons > Toggle Auto Scheduling, and what schedules does this action control?
result.answer:
Before you start, note these restrictions from the cited documentation:
> * For long running PODs, we do not suggest to set this flag since best practice is to keep LifecycleManager Artifacts up to date [doc-0032]

Documented guidance:
- The Pod Add-ons > Toggle Auto Scheduling feature requires the ROLE_PREFLIGHT_AND_FAMILY_ADMIN role in PipelineHub. [doc-0085] [doc-0032]
- This action is used to allow or disallow monthly and quarterly patch bundle patching events. [doc-0085] [doc-0032]

Sources:
- [doc-0085] PipelineHub Preflight - Pod Add-ons - Toggle Auto Scheduling
- [doc-0032] CloudPlatform EnvironmentService Preflight Submission and Monitoring

Links, commands, and configurations in this adapted documentation are illustrative.

retrieved_sources.title: PipelineHub Preflight - Pod Add-ons - Toggle Auto Scheduling
retrieved_sources.text:
#### Disable Monthly and Quarterly Auto Scheduled Patch Bundle Events

This is added as a POD Add On action - please use "Toggle Auto Scheduling" action to allow (and disallow) monthly and quarterly patch bundle patching

* Please note that the Pod Add-ons > Toggle Auto Scheduling feature needs role ROLE_PREFLIGHT_AND_FAMILY_ADMIN in PipelineHub

retrieved_sources.title: CloudPlatform EnvironmentService Preflight Submission and Monitoring
retrieved_sources.text:
* There is Feature flag support to reduce number of times LifecycleManager Artifact Set AUTO Maintenance is triggered via **feature flag : enable-lifecyclemanager-auto-scheduled-upon-register**
* Please read [Schedule LifecycleManager patching with Default LifecycleManager artifact set](https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-402) for more information to determine if setting feature flag (to false), enable-lifecyclemanager-auto-scheduled-upon-register, makes sense for you
* Setting this feature flag to false will disable the scanner that detects if newer LifecycleManager Artifact Sets ought to be auto-scheduled on your POD
* For long running PODs, we do not suggest to set this flag since best practice is to keep LifecycleManager Artifacts up to date

#### Disable Monthly and Quarterly Auto Scheduled Patch Bundle Events

This is added as a POD Add On action - please use "Toggle Auto Scheduling" action to allow (and disallow) monthly and quarterly patch bundle patching

* Please note that the Pod Add-ons > Toggle Auto Scheduling feature needs role ROLE_PREFLIGHT_AND_FAMILY_ADMIN in PipelineHub

#### Applying LifecycleManager Patch on a provisioned pod

With this sprint, we are providing the user to patch a pod with a different LifecycleManager Artifact than the one that is on the pod, as part of provisioning.

This option is provided from the Patching Dashboard.

The LifecycleManager Artifact Patching is available as another Patching Type from the Patching Dashboard.

retrieved_sources.title: PipelineHub Preflight - Post Pod Actions - Toggle MFA
retrieved_sources.text:
Toggle MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) 

1. PipelineHub will have a post pod action Enable/Disable MFA and based on the user choice the post pod action will call the corresponding JC's on the IdentityService or IdentityService/ManagedDatabase pods only , this feature is not available for IDM and the UI should not show this feature for IDM PODs.
2. if MFA is disabled then the users will be able to login with user name and password on the IdentityService and IdentityService/ManagedDatabase pods
3. if the MFA is enabled user will be prompted for extra authentication to be able to login to the PODs
4. if BuildAcceptanceTests are triggered, BuildAcceptanceTests will automatically disable the MFA on the POD as BuildAcceptanceTests cannot run with MFA on, so when BuildAcceptanceTests are triggered the assumption is that MFA will be disabled (this will be done during the BuildAcceptanceTests run) , irrespective of what the user has done during prov or post prov action.

Eligible PODS (IdentityService) will have the option in the post pod actions - TOGGLE MFA

The user will be able to ENABLE MFA or DISABLE MFA based on the option selected (true or false)

This documents provides information on the following :

* How to subscribe a PipelineHub Role to perform certain action via PipelineHub for Onboarding, CI/CD, Preflight, Tagging, Promotion etc.
* What are the kinds of roles available in PipelineHub
* Role Approval Workflow in PipelineHub
* What is the list of Roles available as of a certain date for your easy viewing on this page

Self Service based Role Request
===============================

Please click on the top right corner menu like <User Id> → **My Profile** menu item in the dropdown to navigate to the **My** **Profile** page.

The **My Profile** page will look like below:

If you are an existing PipelineHub user, the following details will already be present :

* **User ID**
* **Primary LOB**
* **Secondary LOBs** (optional)
* **IdentityService Client id** (optional**)**
* **Roles** **Subscribed** (assigned and requested)
* **Ability to control CI/D Projects**
* **Preflight Environments**
* **Family Environments**
* **Ability to control CloudNative Services**
* **Ability to control Applications**

To request a new role, please click on  icon besides "Roles Subscribed"  from your profile page. You'll see a new screen as below.
